articles.title: Hackers Actively Exploit Critical ASP.NET Vulnerability to Execute Remote Code and Compromise Web Servers
articles.summary:
A serious vulnerability in a long-abandoned ASP.NET security library is currently being exploited. This flaw allows unauthorized attackers to take control of IIS web servers with a single HTTP request. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-131914 (MNDT-2026-0048) and involves an insecure deserialization bug (CWE-502) affecting Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll version 0.9.1.0 (also referred to as 0.9.1 Beta). It […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 After Public PoC Release to Gain Root Privileges
articles.summary:
Threat actors have begun exploiting a critical Cisco Expressway flaw, CVE-2026-76466, shortly after a public proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit appeared. The attackers gained root-level remote command execution on internet-facing devices. F6’s Cyber Defense Center investigated the first observed case and reported it on November 19, 2026. The flaw carries a CVSS score of 9.8. Cisco Expressway […]

articles.title: Critical Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Flaws Allow Unauthenticated Attackers to Execute Code Remotely
articles.summary:
Palo Alto Networks has disclosed two critical NGINX vulnerabilities that could let unauthenticated attackers remotely execute arbitrary code or crash worker processes on affected PAN-OS and Panorama deployments. The flaws, tracked as CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, affect specific releases in the PAN-OS 12.2, 12.1, and 11.2 branches. Exposure requires HTTP/2 to be enabled. Palo Alto Networks […]
